edges.reason: msg.sender determines payment source, recipient and mint eligibility inside mint.
mint requires tx.origin == msg.sender to restrict participation to EOAs, an origin-based authorization check.
mint performs the external gold.burn call before tokensMinted and balance accounting are updated.
msg.sender is passed as the account to gold.burn.
The external gold token call can reenter mint while tokensMinted is still stale.
mint queries gold.balanceOf(msg.sender) to verify the payment amount.
mint calls treasureIsland.addTokensToStake after minting loop, allowing reentry from an external contract.
External TreasureIsland staking call can reenter mint before it returns.
mint calls selectRecipient for every token in the mint loop.
selectRecipient returns msg.sender in phase 1 and in the non-steal branch.
selectRecipient calls the external treasureIsland.randomPirateOwner() to pick a thief.
The current phase gates whether stealing can occur in selectRecipient.
mint obtains each token ID via getTokenToBeMinted.
getTokenToBeMinted uses getSomeRandomNumber to choose an index in _availableTokens.
The random seed aggregates the balances of the _randomSource addresses.
mint increments tokensMinted by the user-supplied _amount after payment.
tokensMinted += _amount is the state update whose overflow/underflow would break the MAX_TOKENS cap.
mint reads and writes tokensMinted for cap checks and supply tracking.
mint reads _availableTokens.length to ensure tokens remain in the phase.
mint increments pirateMinted when a pirate token is minted.
mint creates tokens through _safeMint for the recipient or the staking contract.
Safe minting to a contract recipient triggers the untrusted onERC721Received callback.
_safeMint performs the receiver validation through _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
transferFrom delegates the actual ownership update to _transfer.
transferFrom checks _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId) unless the caller is treasureIsland.
The treasureIsland address is trusted implicitly and bypasses the ERC721 approval requirement.
withdraw sends the entire contract balance to the owner-supplied destination.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
switchToSalePhase writes the new phase value.
switchToSalePhase populates _availableTokens for phase 1.
updateRandomIndex increments _randomIndex and wraps it back to zero.
updateRandomIndex monotonically increments the _randomCalls counter.
shuffleSeeds consumes a pseudo-random number from getSomeRandomNumber.
shuffleSeeds repeatedly calls updateRandomIndex in a loop.
The random index is truncated to uint16 before indexing _availableTokens.
getSomeRandomNumber returns uint16(random % _limit), a lossy narrowing cast.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed, letting callers influence randomness.
tokensMinted is mixed into the pseudo-random seed.
The current _randomIndex contributes to the random seed.
The _randomCalls counter contributes to the random seed.
mintPrice multiplies the amount by phasePrice[phase].
mintPrice reads the current phase to select the price.
mint computes the required payment through mintPrice(_amount).
giveAway obtains each token ID via getTokenToBeMinted.
giveAway mints tokens to the designated address using _safeMint.
giveAway checks tokensMinted + _amount against the cap.
MAX_TOKENS bounds the amount mintable through mint.
MINT_PER_TX_LIMIT bounds the per-transaction mint amount.
_balances[from] -= 1 during transfer/burn is an unchecked-arithmetic concern for holder accounting.
_transfer adjusts the sender and receiver balance entries.
_transfer rewrites the _owners entry for the transferred token.
The constructor safe mints token 0 to the deployer.
The constructor mints the first token to msg.sender.
The constructor triggers switchToSalePhase(1, true).
The constructor seeds default phase prices.
The constructor registers the entropy source addresses.
setTreasureIsland rewrites the external TreasureIsland reference.
setGold rewrites the external gold token reference.
changePhasePrice writes directly into the phasePrice mapping.
setPirateId toggles the _isPirate mapping entry.
setPirateIds bulk writes the _isPirate mapping.
addAvailableTokens pushes token ID ranges into _availableTokens.
changeRandomSource rewrites an entropy source address.
setPaused toggles the _paused flag that gates mint.
The whenNotPaused modifier on mint reads _paused.

normalization_plan.reason: Amount parameter only exists as part of the mint call's cap and price logic.
Boolean parameter that branches mint into the staking path.
Local recipient is produced by selectRecipient and consumed inside mint.
Local token ID is the return value of getTokenToBeMinted.
Accumulated gold cost is exactly the amount passed to the external burn call.
Collected token ID array is forwarded to the staking external call.
Seed parameter is only used inside the pseudo-random hash computation.
Limit parameter defines the modulo bound of the truncating cast.
Intermediate hash result local to the random generator.
Summed entropy balances are a temporary accumulator inside the generator.
Range start only flows into the availability population triggered by the phase switch.
Range end only flows into the availability population triggered by the phase switch.
